\section[(dialogue)]{Places and getting around — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R113-first-pass-places-and-getting-around}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a curtain and a cushion.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item an airport, a square; a seat, a museum, a hotel, the post office; the post
  \item a restaurant, a bakery, a cinema, a theatre, a town hall
  \item a supermarket, a petrol station, a swimming pool, a stadium, a factory
  \item an office, a corner, a crossroads, traffic lights, a car park
  \item the north, the south, the east, the west, straight on
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
An airport? (\textbf{der Flughafen}.) A square; a seat? (\textbf{der Platz}.) A museum? (\textbf{das Museum}.) A hotel? (\textbf{das Hotel}.) The post office; the post? (\textbf{die Post}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{das Restaurant}.) A bakery? (\textbf{die Bäckerei}.) A cinema? (\textbf{das Kino}.) A theatre? (\textbf{das Theater}.) A town hall? (\textbf{das Rathaus}.) A supermarket? (\textbf{der Supermarkt}.) A petrol station? (\textbf{die Tankstelle}.) A swimming pool? (\textbf{das Schwimmbad}.) A stadium? (\textbf{das Stadion}.) A factory? (\textbf{die Fabrik}.) An office? (\textbf{das Büro}.) A corner? (\textbf{die Ecke}.) A crossroads? (\textbf{die Kreuzung}.) Traffic lights? (\textbf{die Ampel}.) A car park? (\textbf{der Parkplatz}.) The north? (\textbf{der Norden}.) The south? (\textbf{der Süden}.) The east? (\textbf{der Osten}.) The west? (\textbf{der Westen}.) Straight on? (\textbf{geradeaus}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{The house and things you carry — a second pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R113-second-pass-the-house-and-things-you-carry}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for up and down.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item up, down, at the front, at the back, opposite
  \item next to, between, behind, the underground, a tram
  \item a taxi, a ticket, a suitcase, a lift, to fly
  \item a rug, a television, a computer, a fridge, a cooker
  \item a shower, a bathtub, a shelf, a curtain, a cushion
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Up? (\textbf{oben}.) Down? (\textbf{unten}.) At the front? (\textbf{vorne}.) At the back? (\textbf{hinten}.) Opposite? (\textbf{gegenüber}.) Next to? (\textbf{neben}.) Between? (\textbf{zwischen}.) Behind? (\textbf{hinter}.) The underground? (\textbf{die U-Bahn}.) A tram? (\textbf{die Straßenbahn}.) A taxi? (\textbf{das Taxi}.) A ticket? (\textbf{die Fahrkarte}.) A suitcase? (\textbf{der Koffer}.) A lift? (\textbf{der Aufzug}.) To fly? (\textbf{fliegen}.) A rug? (\textbf{der Teppich}.) A television? (\textbf{der Fernseher}.) A computer? (\textbf{der Computer}.) A fridge? (\textbf{der Kühlschrank}.) A cooker? (\textbf{der Herd}.) A shower? (\textbf{die Dusche}.) A bathtub? (\textbf{die Badewanne}.) A shelf? (\textbf{das Regal}.) A curtain? (\textbf{der Vorhang}.) A cushion? (\textbf{das Kissen}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
